# IR-EMPOWER 2026 in review

The second **IR-EMPOWER** workshop on infrared emissivity measurement took place
on 28–29 September 2026 at the Center for Applied Energy Research (CAE) in
Würzburg: 21 talks, a laboratory tour, two poster sessions and a round table,
with about 40 participants.
